name: Roth.roth
source:
theorem roth {α : ℝ} (hα : Irrational α) (halg : IsAlgebraic ℚ α) {κ : ℝ}
    (hinf : (approxSet α κ).Infinite) : κ ≤ 2 := by
  by_contra! hκ
  obtain ⟨α', κ', hα', hint', hκ', hinf'⟩ := reduction hα halg hκ hinf
  exact (roth_of_isIntegral hα' hint' hinf').not_gt hκ'

what: An irrational real algebraic number has approximation exponent at most two.
how: Assuming a larger exponent, use reduction to produce an algebraic-integer counterexample and contradict roth_of_isIntegral.
